effects.persistence: 45 seconds to 200 years in the mind of the reader

evidence.locator: This has no obvious effects at first, but upon falling asleep, the reader will dream of a fantasy world where they are the protagonist of a troubled land.

constraints: the reader has awakened from an SCP-1230-induced dream

evidence.locator: Upon awaking, the reader is able to remember every aspect of their dream in detail.

effects.trigger: once you read ‘A hero is born’
constraints: the reader reads ‘A hero is born’

evidence.locator: Upon his return, Dr. F███████ reported that SCP-1230-1 appeared in his dreams and explained that once you read ‘A hero is born’, the dream is immediately implanted in your subconscious, after which SCP-1230-1 is able to manipulate it remotely.

constraints: most creatures such as animals would not be affected

evidence.locator: SCP-1230-1 explained to a subsequent dreamer that it is actually only able to affect beings “with an imagination” and that most creatures such as animals would not be affected.
